intro.text: A cobbler with his own shop, who gives street urchins shoes for free and asks only for their stories in return.

items.text: Ym grew up on the streets, though he seems to have been born to a family of means. As a youth he was sent to deliver a bottle of wine to a woman as a message; it was poisoned, and she died. Regretting it, he left crime behind and in time opened a cobbler's shop, where he made shoes for street children.
Ym was killed in his shop by a stranger.
His daughter and granddaughter moved into his shop after his death, and his daughter bonded his mistspren.

personality.text: Kind and selfless, he heals and comforts the children who come to him. He makes his shoe forms by hand, as has been done for centuries, and his faith in the One shapes how he runs his shop: he charges nothing, asking only for people's stories.
